summary.zh: 建立持续跟踪竞品的竞争情报体系
summary.en: A tracking system for competitors, battlecards and win/loss

description.zh: 做竞品分析、对战卡片、赢单与丢单复盘，以及相对替代方案的位置说明。形成的跟踪体系会同时服务定位、销售和产品路线图。适合竞品动作变多、销售需要统一话术的时候。
description.en: Competitor analysis, battlecards, win/loss reviews and positioning against alternatives. The tracking system it builds feeds positioning, sales conversations and the roadmap. For when competitors outrun the sales team.
